tool_pin: Keeper must record actual existing wasm-tools version/path/SHA; no new install requested
runtime_pin: BEFORE only complete immutable R6 source, actual matching SDK/runtime/product; AFTER requires R7 EH-layout rebuilt runtime
invalid_binary_rule: wasm-tools parse preserves invalid module typing; oracle validate must fail; keep emitted raw bytes and product rejection separate

component_before_cases.expected: must reject EH; actual accept is expected before counterexample and failing regression, never PASS
must reject unused signature EH; record actual outcome
must reject encoded zero-count local EH; original JSON hex only, not WAT regeneration

native_cases.name: legal_recursive_gc
native_cases.runtime: exit0; _start invokes actual recursive struct allocation/read

native_cases.name: unused_invalid_gc_packed_get
native_cases.runtime: reject load; unused invalid struct.get_s on unpacked i32 may not pass lazy admission

native_cases.name: unused_invalid_try_table_label
native_cases.runtime: reject load; invalid outer catch label may not pass lazy admission

feature_off_rule: Replace ONLY the matching --wasm-feature-enable-X with --wasm-feature-disable-X; do not add conflicting enable+disable flags. Require related feature diagnostic, not generic crash/reject. GC-off must leave exceptions on and EH-off leave GC on. Test mem64/table64 independently on same combined declarations.
mode_sequence: Short round first actual int full; optional jit full and ordinary int lazy/jit lazy only already matched products after first source-correct result. Every legal _start reaches probes. No large matrix/rebuild per probe.
limits: All native actions sole keeper SSH Linux shared <=64GiB cgroup; no Mac native; P-core for timed performance only, this is untimed semantic smoke.
results_rule: Raw argv, tool/product/headers/source pins, raw status/stdout/stderr, oracle outcome and expected/actual semantic match retained; unavailable backend/SO, parse failure of expected-valid, unrelated crash or diagnostic mismatch are NOT PASS.
